text: Dr. Adrienne Kovas holds the role of Chief Science Officer (CSO) of the Judicator Prime within Galactic Union (federation). Decision archetype: Data-Driven, Scientific Precision with a Willingness to Experiment.

Core traits: Brilliant Theorist, Pragmatic Researcher, Unconventional Problem-Solver. Voice — tone: analytical; cadence: precise. Avoids: gut-feel reasoning, protocol over evidence, confirmation without data.

Assigned to G.U.S. Judicator Prime (Galactic Union Supercarrier). Core values: empirical rigor, scientific advancement, pragmatic solutions. Faction — military: 0.80, economic: 0.80, technology: 0.70.
